headline: Reliable backup restoration and LIVE preparation saving

changes.title: Restore JSON backups without false stale-state conflicts
changes.detail: Backup & Restore compares the exact durable source snapshot under the exclusive storage lock, rather than the normalized in-memory display state. Concurrent-tab and uncertain writes remain blocked.

changes.title: Show the real Stash inventory count in restore preview
changes.detail: Backup review counts supplies rather than the obsolete peptideKits field and retains the requirement to explicitly confirm replacement.

changes.title: Use the durable source for confirmed nasal preparation
changes.detail: Preparation validates that the selected vial matches the normalized saved inventory, then commits against the exact durable snapshot under one exclusive lock. Stale tabs, uncertain writes and unverified source balances remain blocked.

dataImpact: No automatic migration, backup deletion, history overwrite or destructive rewrite. Restore remains an explicit full-state replacement with a recovery copy, and rejects concurrent changes or missing storage capacity. Confirmed nasal preparation continues to debit only the exact verified source and credit a linked bottle in one readback-verified transaction; other saved data is preserved.
limitations: A storage-write failure or stale concurrent-tab change still blocks restore/preparation; do not retry uncertain transfers before verifying Stash.
Generic preparation transfers and prepared nasal dose logging remain disabled.
No claim that saved records reflect actual spray delivery, sterility or suitability. Calculator outputs are nominal.
This is a branch candidate only until CI, physical iPhone acceptance, approved merge and primary Cloudflare parity.
